rewritten_query: select l_returnflag, l_linestatus, sum(l_quantity) as sum_qty, sum(l_extendedprice) as sum_base_price, sum(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount)) as sum_disc_price, sum(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount) * (1 + l_tax)) as sum_charge, avg(l_quantity) as avg_qty, avg(l_extendedprice) as avg_price, avg(l_discount) as avg_disc, count(*) as count_order from lineitem where l_shipdate <= date '1998-12-01' - interval '93' day group by l_returnflag, l_linestatus;

WITH min_cost_europe AS ( SELECT ps_partkey, MIN(ps_supplycost) AS min_cost FROM partsupp JOIN supplier ON supplier.s_suppkey = partsupp.ps_suppkey JOIN nation ON supplier.s_nationkey = nation.n_nationkey JOIN region ON nation.n_regionkey = region.r_regionkey WHERE region.r_name = 'EUROPE' GROUP BY ps_partkey ) SELECT s_acctbal, s_name, n_name, p_partkey, p_mfgr, s_address, s_phone, s_comment FROM part JOIN partsupp ON part.p_partkey = partsupp.ps_partkey JOIN supplier ON supplier.s_suppkey = partsupp.ps_suppkey JOIN nation ON supplier.s_nationkey = nation.n_nationkey JOIN region ON nation.n_regionkey = region.r_regionkey JOIN min_cost_europe ON partsupp.ps_partkey = min_cost_europe.ps_partkey WHERE part.p_size = 6 AND part.p_type LIKE '%NICKEL' AND region.r_name = 'EUROPE' AND partsupp.ps_supplycost = min_cost_europe.min_cost ORDER BY s_acctbal DESC, n_name, s_name, p_partkey LIMIT 100;

WITH min_cost AS ( SELECT ps_partkey, MIN(ps_supplycost) AS min_ps_supplycost FROM partsupp JOIN supplier ON partsupp.ps_suppkey = supplier.s_suppkey JOIN nation ON supplier.s_nationkey = nation.n_nationkey JOIN region ON nation.n_regionkey = region.r_regionkey WHERE region.r_name = 'ASIA' GROUP BY ps_partkey ) SELECT s_acctbal, s_name, n_name, p_partkey, p_mfgr, s_address, s_phone, s_comment FROM (SELECT * FROM part WHERE p_size = 46 AND p_type LIKE '%NICKEL') AS part JOIN partsupp ON part.p_partkey = partsupp.ps_partkey JOIN supplier ON partsupp.ps_suppkey = supplier.s_suppkey JOIN nation ON supplier.s_nationkey = nation.n_nationkey JOIN (SELECT * FROM region WHERE r_name = 'ASIA') AS region ON nation.n_regionkey = region.r_regionkey JOIN min_cost ON partsupp.ps_partkey = min_cost.ps_partkey AND partsupp.ps_supplycost = min_cost.min_ps_supplycost ORDER BY s_acctbal DESC, n_name, s_name, p_partkey LIMIT 100;

WITH min_cost_in_america AS ( SELECT ps_partkey AS min_cost_partkey, MIN(ps_supplycost) AS min_supplycost FROM partsupp, supplier, nation, region WHERE s_suppkey = ps_suppkey AND s_nationkey = n_nationkey AND n_regionkey = r_regionkey AND r_name = 'AMERICA' GROUP BY ps_partkey ) SELECT s_acctbal, s_name, n_name, p_partkey, p_mfgr, s_address, s_phone, s_comment FROM part, supplier, partsupp, nation, region, min_cost_in_america m WHERE p_partkey = ps_partkey AND s_suppkey = ps_suppkey AND p_size = 3 AND p_type LIKE '%NICKEL' AND s_nationkey = n_nationkey AND n_regionkey = r_regionkey AND r_name = 'AMERICA' AND p_partkey = m.min_cost_partkey AND ps_supplycost = m.min_supplycost ORDER BY s_acctbal DESC, n_name, s_name, p_partkey LIMIT 100;

SELECT l_orderkey, SUM(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount)) AS revenue, o_orderdate, o_shippriority FROM (SELECT * FROM customer WHERE c_mktsegment = 'MACHINERY') c JOIN (SELECT * FROM orders WHERE o_orderdate < DATE '1995-03-20') o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN (SELECT * FROM lineitem WHERE l_shipdate > DATE '1995-03-20') l ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey GROUP BY l_orderkey, o_orderdate, o_shippriority ORDER BY revenue DESC, o_orderdate LIMIT 10;

SELECT n_name, SUM(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount)) AS revenue FROM (SELECT * FROM region WHERE r_name = 'AMERICA') r JOIN nation n ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN customer c ON c.c_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN (SELECT * FROM orders WHERE o_orderdate >= DATE '1993-01-01' AND o_orderdate < DATE '1993-01-01' + INTERVAL '1' YEAR) o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey AND l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey GROUP BY n_name ORDER BY revenue DESC;

SELECT supp_nation, cust_nation, l_year, SUM(volume) AS revenue FROM ( SELECT n1_filter.n_name AS supp_nation, n2_filter.n_name AS cust_nation, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM li.l_shipdate) AS l_year, li.l_extendedprice * (1 - li.l_discount) AS volume FROM (SELECT * FROM nation WHERE n_name IN ('CANADA', 'CHINA')) AS n1_filter INNER JOIN supplier s ON s.s_nationkey = n1_filter.n_nationkey INNER JOIN lineitem li ON li.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey AND li.l_shipdate BETWEEN DATE '1995-01-01' AND DATE '1996-12-31' INNER JOIN orders o ON o.o_orderkey = li.l_orderkey INNER JOIN customer c ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey INNER JOIN (SELECT * FROM nation WHERE n_name IN ('CANADA', 'CHINA')) AS n2_filter ON c.c_nationkey = n2_filter.n_nationkey WHERE (n1_filter.n_name = 'CANADA' AND n2_filter.n_name = 'CHINA') OR (n1_filter.n_name = 'CHINA' AND n2_filter.n_name = 'CANADA') ) AS shipping GROUP BY supp_nation, cust_nation, l_year ORDER BY supp_nation, cust_nation, l_year;

SELECT supp_nation, cust_nation, l_year, SUM(volume) AS revenue FROM ( SELECT n1_filtered.n_name AS supp_nation, n2_filtered.n_name AS cust_nation, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l_filtered.l_shipdate) AS l_year, l_filtered.l_extendedprice * (1 - l_filtered.l_discount) AS volume FROM (SELECT * FROM nation WHERE n_name IN ('ETHIOPIA', 'FRANCE')) AS n1_filtered INNER JOIN supplier s ON s.s_nationkey = n1_filtered.n_nationkey INNER JOIN lineitem l_filtered ON s.s_suppkey = l_filtered.l_suppkey AND l_filtered.l_shipdate BETWEEN DATE '1995-01-01' AND DATE '1996-12-31' INNER JOIN orders o ON l_filtered.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey INNER JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey INNER JOIN (SELECT * FROM nation WHERE n_name IN ('ETHIOPIA', 'FRANCE')) AS n2_filtered ON c.c_nationkey = n2_filtered.n_nationkey WHERE (n1_filtered.n_name = 'ETHIOPIA' AND n2_filtered.n_name = 'FRANCE') OR (n1_filtered.n_name = 'FRANCE' AND n2_filtered.n_name = 'ETHIOPIA') ) AS shipping GROUP BY supp_nation, cust_nation, l_year ORDER BY supp_nation, cust_nation, l_year;

SELECT o_year, SUM(CASE WHEN nation = 'FRANCE' THEN volume ELSE 0 END) / SUM(volume) AS mkt_share FROM (SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o_orderdate) AS o_year, l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount) AS volume, n2.n_name AS nation FROM (SELECT * FROM part WHERE p_type = 'SMALL ANODIZED TIN') AS p JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN (SELECT * FROM orders WHERE o_orderdate BETWEEN DATE '1995-01-01' AND DATE '1996-12-31') AS o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN supplier s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN nation n1 ON c.c_nationkey = n1.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n1.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey AND r.r_name = 'EUROPE' JOIN nation n2 ON s.s_nationkey = n2.n_nationkey WHERE n1.n_nationkey = n2.n_nationkey) AS all_nations GROUP BY o_year ORDER BY o_year;

WITH all_nations AS ( SELECT extract(year FROM o_orderdate) AS o_year, l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount) AS volume, n2.n_name AS nation FROM (SELECT * FROM part WHERE p_type = 'LARGE BURNISHED TIN') AS part, supplier, lineitem, (SELECT * FROM orders WHERE o_orderdate BETWEEN DATE '1995-01-01' AND DATE '1996-12-31') AS orders, customer, nation n1, nation n2, (SELECT * FROM region WHERE r_name = 'AFRICA') AS region WHERE p_partkey = l_partkey AND s_suppkey = l_suppkey AND l_orderkey = o_orderkey AND o_custkey = c_custkey AND c_nationkey = n1.n_nationkey AND n1.n_regionkey = r_regionkey AND s_nationkey = n2.n_nationkey ) SELECT o_year, sum(CASE WHEN nation = 'ALGERIA' THEN volume ELSE 0 END) / sum(volume) AS mkt_share FROM all_nations GROUP BY o_year ORDER BY o_year;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, cust_rev.revenue, c.c_acctbal, n.n_name, c.c_address, c.c_phone, c.c_comment FROM customer c JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN ( SELECT o.o_custkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue FROM ( SELECT * FROM orders o WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1993-11-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1994-02-01' ) o JOIN ( SELECT * FROM lineitem l WHERE l.l_returnflag = 'R' ) l ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey GROUP BY o.o_custkey ) cust_rev ON c.c_custkey = cust_rev.o_custkey ORDER BY cust_rev.revenue DESC LIMIT 20;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(l_agg.order_revenue) AS revenue, c.c_acctbal, n.n_name, c.c_address, c.c_phone, c.c_comment FROM customer c JOIN (SELECT * FROM orders WHERE o_orderdate >= DATE '1993-09-01' AND o_orderdate < DATE '1993-09-01' + INTERVAL '3' MONTH) o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN (SELECT l_orderkey, SUM(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount)) AS order_revenue FROM lineitem WHERE l_returnflag = 'R' GROUP BY l_orderkey) l_agg ON l_agg.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_acctbal, c.c_phone, n.n_name, c.c_address, c.c_comment ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 20;

WITH romanian_partsupp AS ( SELECT ps_partkey, ps_supplycost * ps_availqty as part_cost_qty FROM partsupp INNER JOIN supplier ON ps_suppkey = s_suppkey INNER JOIN nation ON s_nationkey = n_nationkey AND n_name = 'ROMANIA' ) SELECT ps_partkey, SUM(part_cost_qty) as value FROM romanian_partsupp GROUP BY ps_partkey HAVING SUM(part_cost_qty) > ( SELECT SUM(part_cost_qty) * 0.0001000000 FROM romanian_partsupp ) ORDER BY value DESC;

WITH filtered_data AS ( SELECT ps_partkey, ps_supplycost, ps_availqty FROM partsupp JOIN supplier ON ps_suppkey = s_suppkey JOIN nation ON s_nationkey = n_nationkey AND n_name = 'IRAN' ) SELECT ps_partkey, SUM(ps_supplycost * ps_availqty) AS value FROM filtered_data GROUP BY ps_partkey HAVING SUM(ps_supplycost * ps_availqty) > ( SELECT SUM(ps_supplycost * ps_availqty) * 0.0001000000 FROM filtered_data ) ORDER BY value DESC;

WITH filtered_data AS ( SELECT ps.ps_partkey, ps.ps_supplycost, ps.ps_availqty FROM partsupp ps INNER JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey INNER JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey AND n.n_name = 'JORDAN' ) SELECT ps_partkey, SUM(ps_supplycost * ps_availqty) AS value FROM filtered_data GROUP BY ps_partkey HAVING SUM(ps_supplycost * ps_availqty) > ( SELECT SUM(ps_supplycost * ps_availqty) * 0.0001000000 FROM filtered_data ) ORDER BY value DESC;

WITH filtered_orders AS (SELECT o_custkey, COUNT(o_orderkey) AS order_cnt_per_cust FROM orders WHERE o_comment NOT LIKE '%special%requests%' GROUP BY o_custkey) SELECT COALESCE(fo.order_cnt_per_cust, 0) AS c_count, COUNT(*) AS custdist FROM customer c LEFT OUTER JOIN filtered_orders fo ON c.c_custkey = fo.o_custkey GROUP BY COALESCE(fo.order_cnt_per_cust, 0) ORDER BY custdist DESC, c_count DESC;

WITH filtered_orders AS (SELECT o_custkey, o_orderkey FROM orders WHERE o_comment NOT LIKE '%unusual%deposits%'), orders_agg AS (SELECT o_custkey, COUNT(o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM filtered_orders GROUP BY o_custkey), c_orders AS (SELECT c_custkey, COALESCE(orders_agg.order_count, 0) AS c_count FROM customer LEFT OUTER JOIN orders_agg ON c_custkey = orders_agg.o_custkey) SELECT c_count, COUNT(*) AS custdist FROM c_orders GROUP BY c_count ORDER BY custdist DESC, c_count DESC;

WITH c_orders_cte AS ( SELECT c.c_custkey, COALESCE(o_agg.order_count, 0) AS c_count FROM customer c LEFT OUTER JOIN ( SELECT o_custkey, COUNT(o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM orders WHERE o_comment NOT LIKE '%express%deposits%' GROUP BY o_custkey ) AS o_agg ON c.c_custkey = o_agg.o_custkey ) SELECT c_count, COUNT(*) AS custdist FROM c_orders_cte GROUP BY c_count ORDER BY custdist DESC, c_count DESC;

WITH part_avg AS ( SELECT l_partkey, 0.2 * AVG(l_quantity) AS avg_qty FROM lineitem GROUP BY l_partkey ) SELECT SUM(l_extendedprice) / 7.0 AS avg_yearly FROM lineitem l JOIN part p ON l.l_partkey = p.p_partkey LEFT JOIN part_avg pa ON l.l_partkey = pa.l_partkey WHERE p.p_brand = 'Brand#35' AND p.p_container = 'LG PKG' AND l.l_quantity < pa.avg_qty;

WITH part_avg_quantity AS ( SELECT l_partkey, 0.2 * AVG(l_quantity) AS avg_threshold FROM lineitem GROUP BY l_partkey ) SELECT SUM(l_extendedprice) / 7.0 AS avg_yearly FROM lineitem l INNER JOIN part p ON l.l_partkey = p.p_partkey INNER JOIN part_avg_quantity paq ON l.l_partkey = paq.l_partkey WHERE p.p_brand = 'Brand#32' AND p.p_container = 'WRAP PKG' AND l.l_quantity < paq.avg_threshold;

WITH quantity_threshold AS ( SELECT l_partkey AS threshold_partkey, 0.2 * AVG(l_quantity) AS threshold_value FROM lineitem GROUP BY l_partkey ) SELECT SUM(l_extendedprice) / 7.0 AS avg_yearly FROM part JOIN lineitem ON p_partkey = l_partkey JOIN quantity_threshold ON l_partkey = threshold_partkey WHERE p_brand = 'Brand#32' AND p_container = 'MED PKG' AND l_quantity < threshold_value;

SELECT c_name, c_custkey, o_orderkey, o_orderdate, o_totalprice, SUM(l_quantity) FROM customer JOIN ( SELECT orders.* FROM orders JOIN ( SELECT l_orderkey FROM lineitem GROUP BY l_orderkey HAVING SUM(l_quantity) > 315 ) AS filtered_orders ON orders.o_orderkey = filtered_orders.l_orderkey ORDER BY o_totalprice DESC, o_orderdate LIMIT 100 ) AS sorted_orders ON customer.c_custkey = sorted_orders.o_custkey JOIN lineitem ON sorted_orders.o_orderkey = lineitem.l_orderkey GROUP BY c_name, c_custkey, o_orderkey, o_orderdate, o_totalprice ORDER BY o_totalprice DESC, o_orderdate LIMIT 100;

SELECT c_name, c_custkey, o_orderkey, o_orderdate, o_totalprice, SUM(l_quantity) FROM customer INNER JOIN ( SELECT o_orderkey, o_custkey, o_orderdate, o_totalprice FROM orders INNER JOIN ( SELECT l_orderkey FROM lineitem GROUP BY l_orderkey HAVING SUM(l_quantity) > 313 ) AS filtered_orders ON orders.o_orderkey = filtered_orders.l_orderkey ORDER BY o_totalprice DESC, o_orderdate LIMIT 100 ) AS sorted_orders ON customer.c_custkey = sorted_orders.o_custkey INNER JOIN lineitem ON sorted_orders.o_orderkey = lineitem.l_orderkey GROUP BY c_name, c_custkey, o_orderkey, o_orderdate, o_totalprice ORDER BY o_totalprice DESC, o_orderdate LIMIT 100;

SELECT c_name, c_custkey, o_orderkey, o_orderdate, o_totalprice, SUM(l_quantity) FROM (SELECT sorted_orders.* FROM (SELECT orders.* FROM orders JOIN (SELECT l_orderkey FROM lineitem GROUP BY l_orderkey HAVING SUM(l_quantity) > 313) AS qualifying_orders ON orders.o_orderkey = qualifying_orders.l_orderkey) AS sorted_orders ORDER BY sorted_orders.o_totalprice DESC, sorted_orders.o_orderdate LIMIT 100) AS top_orders JOIN customer ON top_orders.o_custkey = customer.c_custkey JOIN lineitem ON top_orders.o_orderkey = lineitem.l_orderkey GROUP BY c_name, c_custkey, o_orderkey, o_orderdate, o_totalprice ORDER BY o_totalprice DESC, o_orderdate;

SELECT s_name, s_address FROM supplier INNER JOIN nation ON supplier.s_nationkey = nation.n_nationkey AND nation.n_name = 'GERMANY' INNER JOIN ( SELECT DISTINCT partsupp.ps_suppkey FROM partsupp INNER JOIN part ON partsupp.ps_partkey = part.p_partkey AND part.p_name LIKE 'burnished%' INNER JOIN ( SELECT l_partkey, l_suppkey, 0.5 * SUM(l_quantity) AS half_sum_qty FROM lineitem WHERE l_shipdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND l_shipdate < DATE '1996-01-01' + INTERVAL '1' YEAR GROUP BY l_partkey, l_suppkey ) agg_lineitem ON partsupp.ps_partkey = agg_lineitem.l_partkey AND partsupp.ps_suppkey = agg_lineitem.l_suppkey AND partsupp.ps_availqty > agg_lineitem.half_sum_qty ) filtered_partsupp ON supplier.s_suppkey = filtered_partsupp.ps_suppkey ORDER BY s_name;

SELECT s_name, s_address FROM supplier JOIN nation ON supplier.s_nationkey = nation.n_nationkey AND nation.n_name = 'KENYA' JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT partsupp.ps_suppkey FROM partsupp JOIN (SELECT l_partkey, l_suppkey, 0.5 * SUM(l_quantity) AS half_sum FROM lineitem WHERE l_shipdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND l_shipdate < DATE '1997-01-01' + INTERVAL '1' YEAR GROUP BY l_partkey, l_suppkey) AS agg_lineitem ON partsupp.ps_partkey = agg_lineitem.l_partkey AND partsupp.ps_suppkey = agg_lineitem.l_suppkey AND partsupp.ps_partkey IN (SELECT p_partkey FROM part WHERE p_name LIKE 'spring%') WHERE partsupp.ps_availqty > agg_lineitem.half_sum) AS sub ON supplier.s_suppkey = sub.ps_suppkey ORDER BY s_name;

WITH filtered_part AS ( SELECT p_partkey FROM part WHERE p_name LIKE 'burlywood%' ), lineitem_agg AS ( SELECT l_partkey, l_suppkey, 0.5 * SUM(l_quantity) AS half_total_qty FROM lineitem WHERE l_shipdate >= DATE '1994-01-01' AND l_shipdate < DATE '1995-01-01' GROUP BY l_partkey, l_suppkey ), filtered_nation AS ( SELECT n_nationkey FROM nation WHERE n_name = 'ETHIOPIA' ) SELECT s.s_name, s.s_address FROM supplier s INNER JOIN filtered_nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey INNER JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey INNER JOIN filtered_part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey LEFT JOIN lineitem_agg la ON ps.ps_partkey = la.l_partkey AND ps.ps_suppkey = la.l_suppkey WHERE ps.ps_availqty > COALESCE(la.half_total_qty, 0) ORDER BY s.s_name;
